correctness.rationale: The earlier Laurent–Nogueira plateau theorem gives exactly one mass 1−λ for zero rotation, and for every coprime p/q, q>=2, equal numerator-independent width w_q=(1−λ)²λ^(q−1)/(1−λ^q). Lambert totient identity verifies total mass. Writing τ=−log λ gives w_q=τ² Bτ/(exp(τq)−1), Bτ→1. Möbius inversion for reduced numerators gives discrepancy O(divisor_count(q)||F||C1), summing to O(τ log²(1/τ)); the elementary totient summatory law and Abel summation yield limit density t/(ζ(2)(exp t−1)). Exponential denominator controls rescaled-period tails for all fixed moments. Telescoping lift gives 0<=δ−ρ<=1−λ<=τ. Independent finite arithmetic for λ=.9,.97,.99 gave means 1.464718,1.461793,1.461555 converging to 2ζ(3)/ζ(2), with total mass ≈1. The proof, not those truncated sums, establishes all-orders convergence.
